title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East (Late Show) on 1970-02-13
source: Late show. Recorded by Jim Cooper from seat # BB 108 (2nd row Center) Hitachi trq-222, 2 Hitachi mikes; Transferred  >  sony d5pro2 > dbx 2231 EQ > sony rcd w500c

ai_review.summary: Excellent audience recording of a legendary show featuring an unforgettable Dark Star and mind‑bending Other One, with good sound quality for an AUD source.
ai_review.review: The three‑set performance is hailed as one of the Dead’s finest, highlighted by what many call the greatest Dark Star ever and a surreal, backwards‑like passage in The Other One that leads into a haunting Walking In Jordan close.  The audience (AUD) tape is described as “pretty good” and complete, making the historic show fully accessible despite the inherent limitations of crowd recording.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviewers gave 4‑5 stars and praised both the musical peak (Dark Star, The Other One) and the usable sound of the audience recording; the show quality heavily outweighs modest recording limitations.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers call it a "pretty good AUD" with no major complaints about clarity; being an audience source, some ambient noise is expected but the tape captures the performance well enough for enjoyment.

standout_songs: Walking In Jordan (We Bid You Goodnight version)
show_quality.setlist_flow: Three‑set marathon praised for its arc – the first two sets build to a transcendent third set where The Other One’s experimental middle and the gentle closing with Walking In Jordan create a memorable climax.

band_member_comments.Drums: One reviewer describes an uncanny drum moment that seemed to spill sound over the mix during The Other One, adding to the set’s otherworldly feel.
